app.name: VisaAssist AI
app.tagline: A document checklist from official sources for your Schengen short-stay visa application
app.disclaimer: VisaAssist AI helps you prepare your application; it does not predict or guarantee a visa decision. For the definitive requirements, follow the official source of each item.

home.title: Which documents do you need?
home.lead: Choose your destination and your situation. Every document shows the official source it comes from.
home.fromTurkiye: Application from Türkiye, short-stay (C) visa for tourism

checklist.translationRequired: For this destination, documents not in {{languages}} need a translation.

auth.sideTitle: Prepare your application from official sources

points.sources: Every document and rule is shown with the sentence from its official source.
points.documents: The documents you upload are stored encrypted and deleted 30 days after your trip ends.
points.decision: It does not predict the visa decision; it helps you organise your preparation.

applications.title: My applications
applications.empty: You have no application file yet.
applications.loginRequired: Log in to see your applications.
applications.lead: Each application file is for one trip; your steps and documents are kept in the file.
applications.emptyLead: For your first file, choose the country, your situation and the trip dates.

wizard.title: New application file
wizard.applicationDateHint: How recent documents must be is counted from this date. If left empty, today is used.

problem.missing: Enter the departure and return dates.
problem.endBeforeStart: The return date cannot be before the departure date.
problem.tooLong: A short-stay visa covers a stay of at most {{max}} days.

wizard.lead: Create your application file in three steps; your document list follows your choices.

detail.deleteText: The file, its step history and all documents you uploaded are deleted permanently.
detail.title: {{destination}} application

shell.sourcesText: Every item is shown with the passage of its official source.

consent.title: Consent for uploading documents
consent.intro: To upload documents you need to accept the following.

points.purpose: The documents you upload contain personal data; they are used only to prepare your application.
points.storage: Each document is stored encrypted with its own key; in the application only you can view and download it.
points.photos: Location data in photos is removed before they are stored.
points.retention: Documents are deleted automatically 30 days after your trip ends; you can delete them yourself at any time.
points.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time; all documents you uploaded are then deleted.

consent.accept: I have read and accept this
consent.withdrawWarning: If you withdraw your consent, the documents in all your application files are deleted permanently.
consent.withdrawConfirm: Yes, withdraw consent and delete the documents

upload.drop: Drop the file here or choose a file
upload.hint: PDF, JPEG or PNG · at most {{max}} MB
upload.none: No file has been uploaded for this item yet.
upload.retention: These documents are deleted automatically on {{date}}.

error.tooLarge: A file can have at most {{max}} MB.
error.type: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be uploaded.
error.consent: Accept the consent text before uploading documents.

fields.lead: Enter what the document says; the rules are checked with these details.

explain.passed: The details you entered satisfy this rule.
explain.failed: A detail you entered does not satisfy this rule.
explain.incomplete: A detail this rule reads has not been entered yet.
explain.skipped: The document this rule reads has not been uploaded yet.

check.disclaimer: This is a preliminary check; it says nothing about the visa decision.

issue.too_old: {{document}}: {{field}} is {{value}}; it must be {{expected}} or later.
issue.expires_too_soon: {{document}}: {{field}} is {{value}}; it must be valid until at least {{expected}}.
issue.other_currency: {{document}}: {{field}} was entered as {{value}}; it cannot be compared with {{expected}} (no currency conversion).
issue.not_stated: {{document}}: “{{field}}” must be in the document, but was not entered.
issue.period_too_short: {{document}}: {{field}} is {{value}}; the period must start on {{expected}} at the latest.
issue.period_not_recent: {{document}}: {{field}} is {{value}}; it must be {{expected}} or later.
issue.newest_too_old: {{document}}: the newest document is for {{value}}; one for {{expected}} or later is needed.
issue.reference_missing: {{document}}: nothing can be compared until “{{field}}” is entered.
issue.translation_missing: {{document}}: the document is in {{value}}; a translation into one of these is needed: {{expected}}.
